text:
Maya: mini-pitch  Chair Squeak Festival tomorrow at noon? low-key, 3 rounds (sustain, flair, duet). winner gets a mystery snack box. :sparkles:
Owen: love it. duet round = bring a partner or a plant. my ficus is surprisingly rhythmic. :herb:
Priya: sustainability angle? can we use recycled seat cushions as props? tiny prize if someone uses a recycled prop.
Luca: scoring idea: 1-10 for sustain, 1-10 for flair, +3 for crowd cheer. crowd cheer judged by emoji count.
Ben: I vote for a tiny trophy made from retired headphone parts. I have a stash. :trophy:
Samira: sign me up. I'm bringing a kazoo for accompaniment. also can we do a 60s silent warm-up for people who didn't skip lunch?
Jules: fun fact: my chair's squeak changes key depending on humidity. might be an unfair advantage.
Owen: GIF: https://giphy.com/furniture-fanfare (improv soundtrack)
Maya: Ops note: keep it out of phone booths pls. no squeaks during heads-down hours. OpsBot, any decibel rules?
OpsBot: Reminder: ambient noise policy: avoid sustained noise above 80dB in open areas. Short bursts okay. See #help for exceptions.
Priya: poll: snack selection after event? options: cookies / hummus & veg / mixed nuts. :cookie: :leafy_green: :nut_and_bolt:
Ben: cookies for the win.
Luca: hummus masters rise.
Samira: mixed nuts, unless allergic. add a column to sign-up: allergies.
Maya: schedule draft:
```
12:00 - intro + rules
12:05 - round 1: sustain (60s each)
12:20 - round 2: flair (creative moves)
12:30 - round 3: duet/ensemble
12:40 - scoring + wobble ceremony
```
Priya: Ill run the timer. whos taking score? Ben? Jules?
Ben: happy to score (and build the trophy).
Jules: Ill keep the emoji tally. :raised_hands:
Owen: tiny one-liner submission: "Chair, there it is."
Luca: one-liner: "Squeak if you mean it."
Maya: final: whiteboard by kitchen for sign-ups. 12:00 sharp. winners must perform the victory wobble and accept the headphone-trophy. :clap:
